note: Iowa DNR state park ~9 mi N of Guthrie Center, 930 acres of timber and prairie with CCC-era structures. The campground lies in the woods south of the 17-acre lake's dam, across the park road and a day-use strip (playground, courts) from it; the swim beach, fishing jetties and docks are on the lake (electric trolling motors only), and a boat ramp at the south end reaches the Middle Raccoon River. The four-bedroom Sherburne House rents as a group cabin. 12 miles of trails. --Claude
summary: DNR page, map and ReserveAmerica read: 110 sites (76 electric, 20 with 50 amp; 14 non-electric; 13 tent; buddy; youth group) -> count 120 -> 110; electric 50, max rig 103, pull-through added; flush toilets; 100% reservable, reservation required (fcfs never). Not waterfront stands: every site 'Near Water - no', campground below the dam.
flags: NOT WATERFRONT STANDS (checked): ReserveAmerica tags all 105 parsed sites 'Near Water - no' (no GIS published). Imagery at 0.43 m/px shows the lake's south end closed by a grassed earthen dam with a spillway; below it run the park road, then a day-use strip (playground, sand volleyball, basketball), then the campground road. The northmost pads (41, 58, 59, 85-89) are ~65-80 m from the water and below the dam, so no lake value under the below-dam rule. The DNR map draws the lake's outlet stream through the campground past 36-37, 44-46 and 53; it is a narrow wooded creek under canopy, not resolvable, and the booking site tags those sites not near water, so no creekside lead.
SITE COUNT: 110 on ReserveAmerica (the stored 120 was note prose); 105 rows parsed, the other 5 not on the paged list.
